title: PM-KISAN income support amount
aliases: kisan samman nidhi किसान सम्मान निधि how much kitne paise पैसे money amount rupees instalment kist किस्त 6000 per year salana kisan wale paise किसान वाले पैसे kitna aata कितना आता hai
body: PM-KISAN gives 6000 rupees per year to eligible landholding farmer families. It is paid in three equal instalments of 2000 rupees each, roughly every four months, directly into the bank account linked to the beneficiary.

title: Who is eligible for PM-KISAN
aliases: kisan samman nidhi किसान सम्मान निधि eligible eligibility पात्रता पात्र कौन सरकारी who qualify landholding land record government employee sarkari naukri नौकरी income tax pensioner doctor lawyer excluded not eligible
body: Landholding farmer families whose names appear in the land records of the state are eligible for PM-KISAN. Income tax payers, serving and retired government employees, professionals such as doctors and lawyers, and holders of constitutional posts are excluded.

title: How to apply for PM-KISAN
aliases: kisan samman nidhi किसान सम्मान निधि apply register registration आवेदन नाम जुड़वाएं जोड़ना enroll form kaise how to csc common service centre documents aadhaar patwari
body: To enrol in PM-KISAN a farmer can register at the nearest Common Service Centre or through the village revenue officer. Aadhaar, land record papers and a bank account passbook are needed, and Aadhaar must be seeded with the bank account for payment.

title: PM-KISAN instalment not received
aliases: kisan samman nidhi किसान सम्मान निधि not received nahi aaya नहीं आया pending payment failed status check beneficiary ekyc bank problem
body: If a PM-KISAN instalment has not arrived, the beneficiary status can be checked at a Common Service Centre or with the village revenue officer. The most common causes are incomplete e-KYC, a name mismatch between Aadhaar and bank records, or an inactive bank account.

title: Ayushman Bharat cover amount
aliases: ayushman आयुष्मान pmjay card कार्ड how much kitna limit cover covered amount lakh लाख रुपये तक इलाज treatment insurance cashless per year family
body: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health cover of up to 5 lakh rupees per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospital treatment. Treatment is cashless at empanelled public and private hospitals, and there is no cap on family size or age.

title: Who is eligible for Ayushman Bharat
aliases: ayushman आयुष्मान eligible eligibility पात्र कौन who qualify deprivation socio economic caste census list name check 14555 helpline
body: Eligibility for PM-JAY is decided from the Socio Economic Caste Census deprivation criteria rather than by open application. A family can check whether its name is on the list at a Common Service Centre, at an empanelled hospital help desk, or by calling the helpline 14555.

title: Using the Ayushman card at a hospital
aliases: ayushman आयुष्मान card कार्ड use kaise इस्तेमाल admission भर्ती mitra help desk empanelled hospital अस्पताल procedure show verify
body: At an empanelled hospital the patient shows the Ayushman card or the family identity document at the Ayushman Mitra help desk. The hospital verifies eligibility and provides the treatment cashless, so no payment should be demanded for a covered procedure.

title: Getting an Ayushman card made
aliases: ayushman card banwana कार्ड बनवाना kaise make new apply csc photo aadhaar आयुष्मान
body: If a family is on the PM-JAY list, the Ayushman card is made free of charge at a Common Service Centre or at an empanelled hospital. Aadhaar and the ration card or family identity document are needed, and no fee should be paid to any agent.

title: How to apply for a ration card
aliases: ration card राशन कार्ड new naya apply banwana बनवाना form documents food civil supplies pds application naya ration card banwana hai नया राशन कार्ड बनवाना है kaise
body: A new ration card is applied for at the state food and civil supplies department, either on the state portal or at the ration office or Common Service Centre. Proof of identity, proof of residence and Aadhaar details of all family members are required.

title: Collecting ration in another state
aliases: one nation one ration card portability दूसरे राज्य another state migrant mazdoor biometric any shop राशन
body: Under One Nation One Ration Card a cardholder can collect their food grain entitlement from any fair price shop anywhere in the country using biometric authentication. It is meant for migrant workers who have moved away from the state that issued the card.

title: Correcting a ration card
aliases: ration card correction सुधार name add remove member नाम जोड़ना हटाना update mistake राशन
body: Names can be added to or removed from a ration card at the ration office or the state food portal, with supporting documents such as a birth or death certificate or a marriage certificate. Corrections are free and no agent fee is required.

title: Old age pension for elders
aliases: old age pension वृद्धावस्था पेंशन budhapa elderly bujurg सीनियर sixty 60 age monthly nsap indira gandhi budhape ki pension बुढ़ापे की पेंशन dadaji दादाजी kab se milegi
body: The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension provides a monthly pension to people aged sixty years and above from families below the poverty line. The central contribution increases after the age of eighty, and most states add a further amount on top.

title: Widow pension
aliases: widow pension विधवा पेंशन vidhwa women forty 40 monthly death certificate block office
body: The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension provides a monthly pension to widows aged forty years and above from families below the poverty line. Applications are made at the block office or the Common Service Centre with the death certificate of the spouse.

title: Disability pension
aliases: disability pension विकलांग दिव्यांग पेंशन handicapped certificate udid monthly
body: The Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension provides a monthly pension to people with severe or multiple disabilities from families below the poverty line. A disability certificate or UDID card from the government hospital is required with the application.

title: Ujjwala LPG connection
aliases: ujjwala उज्ज्वला gas connection lpg cylinder सिलेंडर cooking chulha subsidy woman deposit free refill distributor
body: The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana provides a subsidised LPG connection in the name of a woman of the household. The connection includes a deposit free cylinder and a first refill, and the application is made at any LPG distributor with Aadhaar and a bank account.

title: Jan Dhan bank account
aliases: jan dhan जन धन zero balance bank account खाता rupay debit card accident insurance overdraft open
body: A Jan Dhan account is a zero balance bank account that can be opened at any bank branch or business correspondent with Aadhaar. It comes with a RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover, and an overdraft facility after the account has been operated satisfactorily for six months.

title: Health cover for people over seventy
aliases: seventy 70 senior citizen बुजुर्ग elderly vay vandana ayushman age cover regardless income आयुष्मान
body: People aged seventy years and above are eligible for health cover under Ayushman Bharat regardless of family income, through a separate senior citizen card. Enrolment is done at a Common Service Centre or an empanelled hospital with Aadhaar.

title: Savings scheme for a daughter
aliases: sukanya samriddhi सुकन्या daughter beti girl child savings account post office interest
body: The Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened for a girl child below ten years of age at a post office or authorised bank. It earns a fixed rate of interest set by the government and matures when the girl turns twenty one.

title: School scholarships
aliases: scholarship छात्रवृत्ति student school pre matric post matric national portal apply class
body: Government scholarships for school and college students are applied for on the National Scholarship Portal, usually between the middle and the end of the calendar year. The school or college verifies the application, and Aadhaar and a bank account in the student's own name are needed.

title: When in the day to take medicines
aliases: medicine timing दवा का समय kab lena when time before after food खाना khali pet empty stomach gap dadi ki dawai ka time bhool gaya दादी की दवाई का टाइम भूल गया kab deni कब देनी hai
body: Medicines should be taken at the times written on the prescription, and the gap between doses should be kept as even as possible. Some medicines are taken before food and some after food, so ask the pharmacist to mark the strip if the instruction is not clear.

title: Forgetting a dose
aliases: missed dose medicine दवा भूल गए bhool forget forgot miss skip छूट गई late remember double
body: If a dose is missed it should be taken as soon as it is remembered, unless the next dose is already close. Two doses should never be taken together to make up for a missed one, and a doctor should be asked if doses are missed often.

title: Blood pressure medicines must continue
aliases: blood pressure बीपी bp hypertension daily lifelong stop band karna बंद feeling well regular
body: Blood pressure medicines are usually taken every day for a long period, often for life, and should not be stopped just because the person feels well. Stopping without medical advice can be dangerous, so any change must be discussed with a doctor.

title: Diabetes medicine and meals
aliases: diabetes sugar शुगर मधुमेह metformin insulin meal khana skip hypoglycemia shaky sweating
body: Diabetes medicines are timed around meals, so a dose should not be taken if the meal is going to be skipped without asking a doctor first. If the person feels shaky, sweaty or confused they should be given something sweet at once and taken for medical help.

title: Finish the full antibiotic course
aliases: antibiotic एंटीबायोटिक course पूरा complete stop early beech mein feeling better resistance fever बुखार gone theek ho gaya ठीक हो गया stop band बंद kar dein कर दें antibiotic एंटीबायोटिक
body: An antibiotic course should be completed exactly as prescribed even if the person starts feeling better after two or three days. Stopping early lets the infection return and makes the medicine less effective in future.

title: Storing medicines at home
aliases: medicine storage दवा रखना store heat sunlight धूप fridge expiry date children reach
body: Medicines should be kept in a cool dry place away from direct sunlight and out of the reach of children. The expiry date should be checked before use and expired medicines should not be taken.

title: Do not share prescriptions
aliases: share medicine dusre ki dawa दूसरे की दवा same symptoms neighbour relative prescription own
body: Medicines prescribed for one person should not be given to another even when the symptoms look the same, because the dose and the choice of medicine depend on age, weight and other conditions. Each person needs their own prescription.

title: Checking blood pressure at home
aliases: blood pressure machine home check बीपी नापना reading rest arm record
body: When blood pressure is measured at home the person should sit and rest for five minutes first, keep the arm supported at heart level, and record the reading with the date. Readings should be shown to the doctor at the next visit rather than used to change the dose.

title: ORS for loose motions
aliases: ors loose motion दस्त diarrhoea diarrhea child bachcha dehydration jeevan rakshak ghol solution bachche ko dast lag gaye बच्चे को दस्त लग गए kya doon क्या दूँ
body: For loose motions, ORS solution should be given after every loose stool along with the person's normal food and fluids. Medical help should be sought urgently if the person is drowsy, is passing very little urine, has blood in the stool, or is a small child.

title: Fever warning signs
aliases: fever बुखार danger sign when doctor teen din three days breathing stiff neck rash fits confusion doctor डॉक्टर kab dikhana कब दिखाना see a doctor when बुखार में
body: A fever needs medical attention if it lasts more than three days, is very high, or comes with difficulty breathing, a stiff neck, a rash, confusion, or fits. Elderly people and small children should be taken to a doctor earlier rather than later.

title: Free health helpline numbers
aliases: helpline 104 108 ambulance emergency number call advice free phone
body: The number 104 is a free health helpline that can be called for medical advice, and 108 is the free emergency ambulance number in most states. For a serious emergency the ambulance should be called first rather than waiting.

title: Free blood pressure and sugar screening
aliases: checkup जांच test free government health centre wellness screening thirty adults sugar
body: Blood pressure and blood sugar can be checked free of charge at the nearest government health centre or Health and Wellness Centre. Adults above thirty are advised to get checked regularly even when they feel completely well.

title: Antenatal checkups
aliases: pregnancy गर्भावस्था pregnant checkup anc asha anganwadi iron folic tetanus registration four visits
body: A pregnant woman should have at least four antenatal checkups at the nearest health centre, along with iron and folic acid tablets and tetanus vaccination. The ASHA worker in the village can help arrange the visits and the registration.

title: Child immunisation
aliases: vaccination टीकाकरण टीका immunisation child bachcha anganwadi due date card free
body: Child vaccinations are given free at government health centres and anganwadi centres on fixed immunisation days. The immunisation card should be kept safely and brought to every visit so the next due date can be recorded.

title: Free tuberculosis treatment
aliases: tb tuberculosis टीबी khansi cough two weeks free treatment dots nikshay government
body: Tuberculosis testing and treatment are free at government health facilities, and a cough lasting more than two weeks should be tested. The full course must be completed under supervision, and patients receive a monthly nutrition support payment during treatment.

title: Iron deficiency and anaemia
aliases: anaemia anemia खून की कमी iron folic acid tablets weakness pale tired women adolescent
body: Iron and folic acid tablets are given free at government health centres to pregnant women, adolescents and young children to prevent anaemia. Persistent weakness, breathlessness or pale skin should be checked with a blood test rather than treated at home.

title: Heat stroke prevention
aliases: heat stroke लू garmi summer dehydration water shade outdoor work
body: During very hot weather, drinking water frequently, staying in the shade between noon and three, and wearing light clothing prevent heat illness. Someone who becomes confused, stops sweating or collapses in the heat needs emergency medical help.

title: Updating Aadhaar details
aliases: aadhaar आधार update address mobile number change correction enrolment centre
body: Aadhaar address, mobile number and other details are updated at an Aadhaar enrolment centre or on the official portal, with supporting documents. A small fee applies for updates, and no agent should be paid extra.

title: Birth certificate
aliases: birth certificate जन्म प्रमाण पत्र register municipal panchayat twenty one days apply
body: A birth should be registered with the municipal body or gram panchayat within twenty one days, after which the certificate can be collected or downloaded. Late registration is possible with additional documentation and an affidavit.

title: What a Common Service Centre does
aliases: common service centre csc जन सेवा केंद्र services forms government online help village
body: A Common Service Centre is a village level centre where government forms, scheme applications, certificates and payments can be completed online on the citizen's behalf. Fees for most services are fixed and displayed, and receipts should always be asked for.

title: Who can get an EWS certificate
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस economically weaker section आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर certificate प्रमाण पत्र income limit आय सीमा 8 lakh आठ लाख eligible पात्र kaun कौन general category सामान्य वर्ग reservation आरक्षण सर्टिफिकेट kise किसे mil sakta मिल सकता who can get kaun le sakta
body: EWS is for families in the general or unreserved category whose total annual income from all sources is below eight lakh rupees. Anyone already covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation is not eligible. Unlike the OBC non creamy layer test, salary and agricultural income are both counted.

title: Assets that disqualify you from EWS
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस asset संपत्ति land ज़मीन zameen flat फ्लैट plot प्लॉट acre एकड़ disqualify अयोग्य limit सीमा property certificate प्रमाण पत्र
body: Even under the eight lakh income limit, a family cannot get EWS if it owns five acres or more of farm land, a flat of one thousand square feet or more, a residential plot of one hundred square yards or more in a notified town, or two hundred square yards or more elsewhere. Holdings of all family members are added together.

title: Documents for an EWS certificate
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस documents दस्तावेज़ kagaz कागज़ kya chahiye क्या चाहिए aadhaar आधार income proof आय प्रमाण land record ज़मीन affidavit शपथ पत्र self declaration स्वघोषणा photo फोटो certificate प्रमाण पत्र
body: Bring Aadhaar, proof of residence, an income proof such as a salary slip or income certificate, land or property papers to show the asset limits are met, a passport photo, and a signed self declaration. Carry originals along with photocopies. The exact list varies by state, so confirm at the CSC first.

title: Applying for an EWS certificate in Delhi
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस delhi दिल्ली apply आवेदन kaise banwaye कैसे बनवाएं e-district ई-डिस्ट्रिक्ट sdm एसडीएम self declaration स्वघोषणा income asset certificate आय संपत्ति प्रमाण पत्र post भेजना
body: In Delhi the application is made online on the e-District portal. The step people miss is that the original signed self declaration form must still reach the SDM by hand or by post, quoting the acknowledgement number. Without it the application does not move forward. Allow ten to fifteen working days.

title: Applying for an EWS certificate in Bihar
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस bihar बिहार apply आवेदन kaise banwaye कैसे बनवाएं rtps आरटीपीएस service plus khatian खतियान lpc एलपीसी land paper ज़मीन कागज़ block ब्लॉक sdo certificate प्रमाण पत्र
body: In Bihar the application goes through the RTPS Service Plus portal or the block office. Land papers such as the khatian or an LPC are needed to show the asset limit is met, along with a residence certificate and a self declaration. Certificates are issued at block, sub divisional and district levels. Allow about ten working days.

title: How long an EWS certificate is valid
aliases: ews ईडब्ल्यूएस validity वैधता valid कब तक kab tak expire financial year वित्तीय वर्ष renew दोबारा banwana फिर से certificate प्रमाण पत्र
body: An EWS certificate is issued for one financial year and is checked against that year's income. For an admission or a job application it usually has to be dated within the same financial year as the application, so a certificate from last year may be refused. Apply for a fresh one each year you need it.

title: Who can get an OBC non creamy layer certificate
aliases: obc ओबीसी ncl non creamy layer नॉन क्रीमी लेयर certificate प्रमाण पत्र income limit आय सीमा 8 lakh आठ लाख eligible पात्र creamy layer क्रीमी लेयर difference अंतर kaun कौन
body: The OBC non creamy layer limit is also eight lakh rupees a year, but it is measured differently from EWS: income from salary and from agricultural land is generally left out of the test. The caste must be on the central or state OBC list. The certificate is usually valid for one year.

title: Applying for an OBC non creamy layer certificate
aliases: obc ओबीसी ncl non creamy layer नॉन क्रीमी लेयर apply आवेदन kaise banwaye कैसे बनवाएं tehsildar तहसीलदार documents दस्तावेज़ caste जाति income proof csc certificate प्रमाण पत्र
body: Apply at the tehsil or block office, or through the state e-services portal or a CSC. Bring Aadhaar, a caste proof such as a parent's caste certificate, income proof for the family, and a residence proof. The certificate is signed by a revenue officer, usually the tehsildar or above. It must be issued in the year you use it.

title: Getting an SC or ST caste certificate
aliases: sc st एससी एसटी scheduled caste tribe अनुसूचित जाति जनजाति caste certificate जाति प्रमाण पत्र apply आवेदन kaise banwaye कैसे बनवाएं tehsildar तहसीलदार documents
body: SC and ST certificates are issued by the tehsildar or sub divisional officer of the place where the family lives. Bring Aadhaar, a residence proof, and a caste proof such as a parent's or relative's certificate or a school record showing caste. Unlike EWS and OBC there is no income test. Apply at the block office or through a CSC.

title: Where a reservation certificate is used
aliases: reservation आरक्षण certificate प्रमाण पत्र use इस्तेमाल kahan कहाँ admission दाखिला college कॉलेज job नौकरी sarkari सरकारी exam परीक्षा scholarship छात्रवृत्ति ews obc sc st benefit फायदा
body: The certificate is asked for at college admission, in government job applications, in entrance exams for reserved seats, and for scholarships. It is checked at the time of counselling or document verification, not just on the form. Keep two attested copies ready, and make sure it is from the correct financial year.

title: Official fee for a certificate, and what to do if asked for more
aliases: certificate प्रमाण पत्र fee शुल्क fees paisa पैसा rishwat रिश्वत bribe officer अधिकारी extra ज़्यादा maange माँगे complaint शिकायत grievance kahan कहाँ karein करें receipt रसीद
body: The official fee for a caste, income or EWS certificate is small, often under fifty rupees, and a receipt is always due. Nobody is entitled to any payment beyond that. If someone asks for more, do not pay. Note the name and date and complain to the block officer, the district collector's grievance cell, or the state online grievance portal.

title: Snakebite first aid
aliases: snake साँप sanp bite काटा kaat liya काट लिया snakebite सर्पदंश what to do क्या करें first aid प्राथमिक उपचार tourniquet cut चीरा suck चूसना hospital अस्पताल
body: Keep the person still and calm and do not let them walk. Keep the bitten limb below heart level and take off rings, bangles and tight clothing before swelling starts. Do not cut the wound, suck it, tie a tight band, or apply anything. Get to a hospital as fast as possible; anti venom is free at government hospitals.

title: Snakebite danger signs
aliases: snake साँप sanp bite काटा snakebite सर्पदंश danger signs खतरे के लक्षण serious गंभीर swelling सूजन bleeding खून vomiting उल्टी drowsy नींद breathing साँस emergency
body: Go to the emergency room immediately if there is spreading swelling, bleeding from the bite or the gums, drooping eyelids, difficulty swallowing or breathing, drowsiness, vomiting, or dark urine. These can start within minutes or take hours. Do not wait to see if symptoms appear; the journey to hospital should begin at the bite.

title: Food poisoning first aid
aliases: food poisoning फूड पॉइज़निंग khana खाना kharab खराब ulti उल्टी vomiting dast दस्त diarrhoea loose motion pet dard पेट दर्द stomach what to do क्या करें ors ओआरएस
body: Give small sips of ORS or clean water often, even if the person is vomiting. Keep eating light food like khichdi or bananas once vomiting settles. Do not give anti diarrhoea tablets to children. Wash hands and keep the sick person's utensils separate. Most cases settle in a day or two with fluids.

title: When food poisoning needs a doctor
aliases: food poisoning फूड पॉइज़निंग ulti उल्टी dast दस्त diarrhoea danger signs खतरे के लक्षण serious गंभीर blood खून no urine पेशाब नहीं fever बुखार bachcha बच्चा child doctor kab कब
body: See a doctor the same day if there is blood in the stool, a high fever, no urine for six hours, a very dry mouth, drowsiness or confusion, or if the person is under one year or over sixty. Vomiting that stops all fluids for more than a few hours also needs a doctor. Call 104 if you are unsure.

title: When first aid is not enough
aliases: emergency आपातकाल first aid प्राथमिक उपचार hospital अस्पताल ambulance एम्बुलेंस 108 call karein कॉल करें doctor kab कब serious गंभीर unconscious बेहोश
body: First aid keeps someone safe until they reach care; it does not replace it. Call 108 for a free ambulance if a person is unconscious, has trouble breathing, is bleeding heavily, or has had a snakebite. For anything you are unsure about, call the health helpline on 104. Say the village name first so help can find you.

title: Do not stop TB medicine when you feel better
aliases: tb टीबी tuberculosis क्षय रोग medicine दवाई dawai band बंद stop chhod dena छोड़ देना aaram आराम feel better theek ठीक lag raha लग रहा do mahine दो महीने drug resistant course पूरा
body: Feeling better after a month or two is expected, but the bacteria are still there. TB treatment is at least six months and every dose matters. Stopping early or missing doses is how drug resistant TB starts, which takes far longer to treat and is much harder. Finish the full course exactly as the DOTS centre prescribed.

title: Protecting the family from TB at home
aliases: tb टीबी tuberculosis ghar घर family परिवार bachao बचाओ protect fail फैल spread mask मास्क alag sona अलग सोना separate room कमरा khansi खाँसी cough bachche बच्चे
body: A person on TB treatment usually stops spreading it after two to three weeks of regular medicine. Until the doctor says so, they should cover coughs, wear a mask near others, sleep in a separate well aired room if possible, and keep windows open. Do not share cups. Small children and the elderly should keep some distance in the first weeks.

title: TB check for family members
aliases: tb टीबी tuberculosis family परिवार ghar घर contact test जाँच screening check bachche बच्चे jaanch karwana जाँच करवाना free मुफ्त dots
body: Everyone living in the same house as a TB patient should be checked, even without symptoms. The test is free at the government health centre or DOTS centre. Children under six in the house may be given preventive medicine. Ask the health worker to arrange the household screening when treatment starts.

title: TB warning signs during treatment
aliases: tb टीबी tuberculosis treatment ilaj इलाज warning signs खतरे के लक्षण khoon खून blood cough खाँसी fever बुखार weight वज़न saans साँस breathing side effect yellow पीला eyes doctor kab कब
body: See the TB centre urgently if there is blood in the cough, fever that does not settle, breathlessness, yellow eyes or skin, severe stomach pain, vision changes, or steady weight loss despite treatment. These can be the illness or a side effect of the medicine. Do not stop or change the dose yourself; the doctor may adjust it.

title: Where to get TB treatment

body: TB treatment is free at every government health centre, PHC and district hospital under the national programme, including all medicines and tests. Ask for the DOTS centre. title: Reporting crop loss after flood, drought or hail

body: Report the damage within seventy two hours. Call the crop insurance helpline on 14447, or use the Crop Insurance app, or tell your bank branch or the agriculture or revenue officer. Note the date, the crop, the cause and the area affected, and take photos. Late reporting is the most common reason a claim is refused.

title: Claiming crop insurance under Fasal Bima

body: After the loss is reported, the insurance company sends a surveyor within a few days to assess the field, so do not clear or replant before the visit. Keep the report ticket number, land papers and bank details ready. Claims are paid into the bank account linked to the policy. If nothing happens in a month, call 14447 with the ticket number.

title: Relief for crop loss without insurance

body: Even without insurance, farmers in a notified disaster area can get relief from the state disaster fund. The patwari or revenue officer records the damage in a field survey called girdawari, and relief is paid per acre for losses above a third of the crop. Report the loss to the tehsil quickly and ask for the survey to include your field.

body: If the area is declared a natural calamity, banks are required to offer relief on farm loans: the repayment can be rescheduled, a short term crop loan can be converted into a term loan over several years, and a fresh loan for the next season can be given. Go to the branch with the loss report and ask for restructuring. Nobody can promise a waiver; ask what the bank can offer.

title: What a Kisan Credit Card is

body: A Kisan Credit Card is a bank loan for farming costs like seed and fertiliser, with interest of about four percent a year if repaid on time. Any farmer with land records, including tenant farmers with proof, can apply at a bank branch with Aadhaar, land papers and a photo. It also covers crop insurance under Fasal Bima automatically.
